note: The keys of the terminal panel and chat box (`iohr`, cli/crates/iohr/src/panel). Each row names the file that binds it and a literal that must still be in that file (a test checks), and, where the web UI has the same meaning, the id of its binding. `agree` is how the two compare: same (the same keys do the same), differs (a key means something else on the web) or terminal (no web equivalent).
